page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The CPU cache configuration includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor, does not include any local storage, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data positions this instance in the average tier across most standard compute and memory operations. The stress-ng single-core performance is 1434.29, and the multi-core performance is 7647.48. Memory bandwidth tests show 427.07 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 49.41 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 37.03 GB/sec for large-block writes. In application-specific tests, the instance achieves a static web serving throughput of 6.99 GB/sec and processes 7.45 million Redis SET operations per second.

A key performance tradeoff is observed in large-scale language model processing. While the instance handles small 135M LLM models with average performance, its performance on medium 7B models is poor, dropping to 11.53 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 6.28 tokens/sec for text generation. Given the lack of local storage and the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, database operations, and software compilation rather than memory-heavy databases or large-scale AI inference.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, it lacks local storage and provides a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark results place its compute and memory performance consistently in the average tier, with a PassMark CPU score of 8999.79 and a static web serving throughput of 6.99 GB/sec. However, it exhibits poor performance on medium 7B LLM inference tasks, generating only 6.28 tokens per second. This instance is best suited for general-purpose applications, web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations that do not require local NVMe storage or high-capacity GPU acceleration.
